real_defects.issue: The 'within tolerance' SOV (offered on the page as the least change that brings every line inside the band) failed its own check: withinTolerance left lines exactly on the band's edge and plain largest-remainder rounding pushed them just outside, so re-checking it flagged 4/3/4 of the 10 sample lines (cent/dollar/hundred rounding) with high findings; 1,666 of 3,000 random schedules failed. Fixed with roundWithin (bounded largest-remainder rounding to each line's band), a re-check test at all three units and a seeded 300-schedule property test; after the fix 0 of 3,000 fail where the band holds a whole unit.
